description.short: Explore sample sales with charts, trends, comparisons and drill-downs.
description.full:
Turn fictional 2025 sales into clear charts, right in Teams or Microsoft 365 Copilot.

Ask about revenue, profit, orders or units. Compare regions, countries, products, categories and sales channels; follow monthly trends; filter your results; and drill from a region into its countries.

Try a regional revenue bar chart, monthly revenue lines, an orders-by-channel donut, or a revenue heatmap. Follow up with requests such as "Focus on Europe" or "Break that down by country."

Where your client supports them, simple charts appear as native Adaptive Cards. More complex visualizations, such as heatmaps and scatter plots, are delivered as chart images. Available chart controls and interactions depend on the client.

This Microsoft Foundry demonstration uses synthetic data only. It does not read your organization's databases, documents or uploaded files, and it is not intended for financial decisions.
